entries.name: Foxkin
entries.content: It's a race of Humanoids with fox-like features, including sharp ears and sleek fox tail. Being a hybrid between foxes and humans, they naturally do not have human-like ears, but only fox ears, which they have on top of their heads. Because of this they have an impressive sensory and auditory capacity, being able to hear things thousands of miles away unlike a normal human. Agile and cunning, they are natural hunters and skilled illusionists, often excelling in stealth and trickery. Their culture values wit and adaptability, with tight-knit clans that revere nature and the symbolism of the fox. While enigmatic to many, Foxkin are fiercely loyal allies and often serve as scouts, spies, or mediators in the kingdom. They are both respected and mistrusted for their cleverness, embodying the balance between wild instinct and calculated intellect. They tend to live in forests in the wild and are usually alien to human culture.
